_comment: Optional human kit overrides. Keys are exact god names from the wiki. Global dead items are banned in conquest_builds.REMOVED_OR_UNAVAILABLE_ITEM_KEYS.
_global_unavailable_note: Eye of Providence: wiki still lists it; players report not in live shop — hard-banned in engine.

Cu Chulainn._why: Solo identity: max-HP sustain (Yogi's) + melee aura (Mystical Mail). Mana→HP passive makes Yogi's core; fights in melee range for Mystical ticks. Not ADC/assassin toys.

Aspect of the Death March._why: Ah Puch Death March: Corpse Explosion → Wraith Call (haunt + stacking STR/INT/prot shred; zombies scale off Max Health). Ult deals less damage but slows haunted targets. Corpses refund Fleeting Breath CD. Play as HP-scaling shred Solo or debuff Support — not glass Mid INT burst and not Lotus Sickle enchanter (no ally heals/buffs).
